text:
Elaine: Heads-up — draft launch post cadence + webinar hook storyboard is ready. Need alignment on the benchmark narrative and how we gate starter credits.
Raj: Link? happy to skim and flag gaps.
Elaine: https://docs.redwood.internal/launch/storyboard (mock link) — main asks: benchmark headline, primary CTA, and whether credits are time-limited or action-gated.
Sophie: Quick thought — A/B test two onboarding prompt template bundles (dev vs product examples). One gets 100 free tokens, the other gets credit coupon after first successful API call.
Leo: Agree. Also we should sync the benchmark narrative to the webinar agenda — show a latency/cost benchmark slide vs competitors, then demo prompt templates in-session.
Kyle: For inbound routing: can we route webinar signups with engagement score > 3 straight to an activation flow with a prompt-pack in-app? Otherwise put them into a nurture drip.
Sophie: Yep — mapping idea: webinar > engaged (watched 50%+) -> immediate in-app promptpack + 100 credits; low-engage -> email drip + 30 credits after first API call.
Elaine: Draft experiment config below — basic. can we land on metrics?
experiment: post_launch_onboard_v1
variants:
  - prompt_pack: dev_examples
    credit_policy: immediate_100
  - prompt_pack: product_examples
    credit_policy: coupon_after_call_50
metrics:
  - activation_7d
  - avg_tokens_per_user_14d

Leo: Metrics: activation_7d (primary), retention_14d (secondary), cost_per_acq (calc using tokens consumed).
Raj: Who owns the launch post copy? I can polish but need a one-paragraph hero and 3 bullets.
Elaine: I put a hero draft below — please riff.
Elaine: "Ship LLM features faster: Redwood reduces inference costs and simplifies rollout. Join our product walkthrough + hands-on workshop — get curated prompt templates and starter credits to build a real feature in <1 hour>."
Sophie: Love it. Suggest swapping 'starter credits' -> 'starter credits (redeemable via in-app coupon)'. clearer for enterprise.
Leo: I'll own the dashboard: will add a per-cohort breakdown (webinar vs organic) and a prompt-template slice. ETA EOD Wed.
growth-bot: Experiment created: exp_postlaunch_647, status: draft.
ops-bot: FYI — marketing email send window reserved 2024-11-09 14:00 PT. Confirm creative by Tue EOD or it slides.
Kyle: Roadmap to prod routing: I can add the webhook mapping for webinar tool -> routing service. Need final mapping by Tue.
Raj: Copy owners: Raj (post), Elaine (storyboard), Sophie (experiment plan), Leo (dashboard), Kyle (routing).
Elaine: Next steps: finalize benchmark slide (Raj + Leo), lock credit gating logic (Sophie + Kyle), finalize launch post copy (Raj), prep webinar demo prompt pack (Sophie). Deadline: Tue EOD.
Sophie: :thumbsup: will post a shorter prompt template to #docs for review.
Leo: Ping me if you need sample queries for benchmarks — I'll add them to the doc.
Elaine: Thanks team — quick sync Wed 10am to close outstanding items.
